title: Plant and Animal Cells
summary: The nucleus, membrane, cytoplasm and mitochondria in all cells, plus the cell wall, chloroplasts and large vacuole in plant cells.

ib.note: Organelles such as ribosomes and ER follow in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
Earlier NCERT Ch 8: Cell: Structure and Functions

objectives: I can name the main parts of plant and animal cells and state what each does.
I can compare plant and animal cells, giving three differences.
I can identify cells as plant or animal from what I see under a microscope.
misconceptions: Animal cells have a cell wall.
The cell membrane and the cell wall are the same thing.
